content_of_post_to_comment: Charismatic, overly polished public intellectuals and spiritual teachers make me suspicious. They can produce an extraordinarily convincing performance of comprehension, yet it lacks substance beneath. There’s a difference between being able to manipulate a map and knowing the territory. What signals tell you that someone is the real deal?
comment: The tricky part is that depth often looks less impressive than fluency. Perhaps a better test is whether someone can admit uncertainty, revise their map, and still remain useful when the terrain changes.
